evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Story provides the creation capability for games, which is complemented by read, update, and delete stories elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators is a necessary step and is not missing any complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Viewing items is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection is supported by item creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items
evaluations.rationale: Provides the creation capability for items, complementing read, update, and delete.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Editing is complemented by item creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list
evaluations.rationale: Deletion is complemented by item creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Estimate display is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting estimates is supported by estimate creation and display stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically
evaluations.rationale: Automatic estimate entry is a complementary feature to manual entry.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual estimate entry is supported by estimate creation and display stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is supported by item and estimate management stories.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories is a complementary way to create items, supported by item management.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is another way to create items, complementing item management.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing is supported by game creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts is supported by game and estimate management.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting is a complementary feature to viewing and managing transcripts.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting is a complementary feature to viewing and managing transcripts.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Game deletion is complemented by game creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is complemented by login, update, and delete stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is complemented by account creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account update is complemented by account creation and deletion.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is complemented by account creation and update.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a feature that does not require complementary CRUD operations.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is a complementary feature to account management.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting estimation scales is a feature that does not require complementary CRUD operations.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Extends the invitation feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name
evaluations.rationale: Joining a game is supported by game creation and invitation stories.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Viewing items is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Viewing items is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Estimate display is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time
evaluations.rationale: Estimate display is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Estimate change is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Estimate display is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer
evaluations.rationale: Timer feature is self-contained and does not require complementary CRUD operations.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Timer reset is a complementary feature to the timer and estimation process.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior rounds is supported by item and estimate management stories.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order
evaluations.rationale: Card order is a display feature and does not require complementary CRUD operations.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Estimate change is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed
evaluations.rationale: Photo display is a feature that does not require complementary CRUD operations.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Compliance is a non-functional requirement and does not require CRUD complements.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Definitions are a documentation feature and do not require CRUD complements.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexes are a technical feature and do not require CRUD complements.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility is a non-functional requirement and does not require CRUD complements.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility is a non-functional requirement and does not require CRUD complements.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance is a non-functional requirement and does not require CRUD complements.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a non-functional requirement and does not require CRUD complements.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL structure is a non-functional requirement and does not require CRUD complements.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error pages are a non-functional requirement and do not require CRUD complements.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymization is a data handling feature and does not require CRUD complements.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics are a reporting feature and do not require CRUD complements.
